title: Father's Cause of Death
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji tightly gripped the Tianji Record Fragment, killing intent deep as an abyss in his eyes. He looked up at the sky shrouded in dark clouds, and made a vow in his heart—Heaven's Eye, one day he would crush it with his own hands.

text.content: Night was as dark as ink, the cold wind carrying moisture from the depths of distant mountains quietly passed through the dilapidated window lattice. Chen Ji sat alone in the Servants' Quarters, clutching the black Jade Slip that Ye Qing had left behind when she departed. The jade slip's surface was ice-cold, yet it seemed to constantly burn his palm. The words "Father's death was by no means from illness" were like a blunt knife,来回拉扯 his heart, each breath accompanied by a faint ache.

He closed his eyes, and his father's withered face from his deathbed surfaced once more. That was a rainy night three years ago, his father lying on a simple bed, breath as faint as a gossamer thread, yet refusing to close his eyes until the end. He held his father's ice-cold hand and heard that hoarse voice, barely audible: "Ji'er... survive... no matter what happens... survive..." At the time he thought it was merely his father's rambling in his final moments, but now he realized those words carried far too much weight that he could not fathom.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's figure emerged from the shadows once more, her voice low and certain) "You always believed he died of illness, didn't you? Everyone in Tianqing Sect said Chen Xuan succumbed to exhaustion with no hope of recovery. You believed it for so many years, never doubting."

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, his knuckles white from excessive force. Ye Qing walked closer slowly, moonlight through the window lattice's gaps falling upon her pallid face, reflecting a complex expression. She sat across from Chen Ji, hands folded upon her lap, seemingly considering how to begin speaking. The room's furnishings were simple, a tiny oil lamp flickering in the wind, stretching their shadows long and short alternately.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing took a deep breath and finally spoke) "Chen Xuan... was killed while being pursued by Heaven's Eye."

text.content: These seven words exploded like thunder in the cramped Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji jerked his head up, pupils suddenly contracting. His breathing became rapid, chest heaving violently, as if an invisible hand was choking his throat. The oil lamp's flame flickered violently, seemingly also shaken by the shocking secret within those words.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice carried no emotion whatsoever, yet each word was like a blade) "Heaven's Eye is not merely an illusory existence—it is the Will itself beyond mortals and immortals. Whenever a prophet awakens and threatens its arrangement, it personally intervenes. Chen Xuan... was the target it locked onto."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a loud buzzing fill his mind. He recalled his father's deep eyes that always carried worry, those years when his father sat alone in the courtyard gazing at the night sky in silence, whenever he asked about the origin of the Tianji Record and his father gave evasive answers. So behind those ordinary days he thought they had lived, such terrifying truth was hidden.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing continued, her gaze falling upon the Jade Slip Chen Ji tightly held) "When Heaven's Eye tracked down the aura of the Tianji Record back then, Chen Xuan knew he was no match, yet he did not choose to flee. He revealed himself proactively, drawing the pursuers' attention to himself, all to buy time for you three children to escape."

choice.prompt: After learning the truth of his father's death, Chen Ji faced a choice. He could endure the sorrow and continue asking, or suppress his emotions and digest this alone.

choices.description: Suppress the turmoil within, continue asking Ye Qing about the full process of his father's sacrifice
choices.risk_hint: May Expose Weakness Due to Emotional Loss of Control

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji took a deep breath, voice low and restrained) "...How did he die?"

text.content: He forced himself to meet Ye Qing's eyes directly, not letting the surging bitterness in his eye sockets turn into tears. His fingernails dug deeply into his palms, that stinging pain instead clearing his thoughts slightly. The truth was indeed like a blade, but he needed to know where this blade came from.

choices.description: Let Ye Qing leave temporarily, face this cruel truth alone
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing May Not Elaborate Further

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his chest heaving violently a few times, then forcibly suppressed it. When he opened his eyes again, those pupils had recovered their usual calm, only with a darkness deep within even Ye Qing could not see through. He waved his hand, signaling Ye Qing to withdraw first. Some truths, he needed to digest alone.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice echoed in the silent Servants' Quarters, carrying a cruelty close to tenderness) "He used his own life as the price, sealing the aura of the Heavenly Fate Key, so that Heaven's Eye could not lock onto your position again in a short time. The validity period of this seal is—ten years."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank heavily. Ten years... Father died three years ago, now exactly the critical point when the seal's effect begins to fade. He recalled the series of changes that had occurred to him recently—the awakening of the Tianji Record Fragment, the strengthening of his foresight ability, the fatal backlash of fate... everything seemed to confirm Ye Qing's words were true. The ten years of peace their father traded his life for indeed had an end.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's gaze fell upon the position of Chen Ji's chest, where a faint glimmer of light faintly shone through) "You carry a fragment of the Tianji Record, don't you? Not just a fragment... Chen Xuan, before his death, divided the core inheritance of the Tianji Record into three parts, hiding them within the bodies of you three siblings."

text.content: Chen Ji下意识 pressed his hand against his chest, the warm sensation passing through his thin clothing. He had always thought the Tianji Record was merely a fragment that accidentally fell into his hands, never suspecting this was all his father's premeditated arrangement. His father's words before death, "survive," now held another layer of meaning—not just hope, but also inheritance and trust.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing rose and walked to the window, moonlight making her profile pale as jade) "Your sister Chen Nian was taken by the Holy Sect, serving as the 'Heavenly Fate Key.' Her existence interferes with the Tianji Record's foresight—any foresight scene with her in it is blurred. And your brother..."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing hesitated when mentioning his brother, Chen Ji had to react.

choices.description: Must Know Brother Chen Nian's News No Matter What
choices.risk_hint: The Truth May Be Even More Cruel

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned hoarse, fist clenching) "My brother... what happened to him?"

text.content: Chen Nian's name squeezed from his throat, carrying three years of undiminished longing and worry. He was only ten years old the day his brother disappeared, that back that always stood in front of him, shielding him from all scolding—how could he forget?

choices.description: Some Truths May Be More Cruel Than Not Knowing

text.content: Chen Ji closed his mouth. Some answers, he was not sure he could bear. His father's death had already brought him to the brink of collapse, if his brother was also dead or dying... He feared he would go completely mad this very night.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then finally spoke) "Chen Nian... after disappearing that night, was taken by a mysterious force, whereabouts unknown to this day. But one thing is certain—he is still alive."

text.content: The three words "still alive" were like a faint ray of light, penetrating the darkness shrouding Chen Ji's heart. Three years, this was the first time he heard definite news about his brother. The bitterness accumulated in his eye sockets finally turned into two streams of clear tears, sliding silently down his cheeks. He did not wipe them, only letting that warm liquid flow over his lips, dripping onto his ice-cold hand.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's tone was rarely tinged with gentleness) "Chen Xuan divided the core of the Tianji Record into three parts. You inherited the ability of 'deduction,' your sister inherited the ability of 'sealing,' and Chen Nian... inherited the ability of 'severance.' Only when the three are unified can the complete Tianji Record be formed."

text.content: Chen Ji shuddered throughout. Deduction, sealing, severance... the three complement each other, indispensable. He finally understood why the Tianji Record Fragment's foresight was always incomplete, why fate's backlash grew more severe with each occurrence—from the beginning, what he held was merely an incomplete fragment.

choice.prompt: After learning the truth of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji needed to decide his next move.

choices.description: Sister is the Heavenly Fate Key, must find her as soon as possible

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji wiped away tears, eyes burning with resolute light) "Chen Nian... she's in the Holy Sect? I must find her."

text.content: His sister was taken by the Holy Sect, this was the first time in three years he had a definite direction. Even if dragon's pool and tiger's lair lay ahead, he must make the journey. She was the one their father protected with his life, also his only remaining blood relative in this world.

choices.description: Brother is still alive and possesses the power of severance
choices.process_label: decide to find Chen Nian years

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji meditated for a moment, eyes flickering) "Chen Nian is in the Holy Sect, should be safe for now. But my brother... his whereabouts unknown, even more worrying."

text.content: He had a premonition that his brother's disappearance was by no means coincidence. That mysterious force took Chen Nian, surely for some purpose. If he did not find him quickly, more complications would surely arise.

Ye Qing quietly watched Chen Ji go through the entire process of shock to sorrow, sorrow to anger, then recovering reason from anger, all within a quarter hour. She suddenly understood why this seemingly useless servant disciple could conceal himself in Tianqing Sect for three years without exposing a single detail. This man's heart was far harder than his outward appearance.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing said finally, voice low) "Chen Xuan arranged everything before his death, including my appearance. He knew I would be pursued by the Holy Sect, knew I would be driven to desperation, and also knew... that I would tell you all of this. He calculated me into his chess game as well."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his father's thin yet steadfast face surfacing in his mind. So from that time, his father was already laying the groundwork for today. He used his own death as the catalyst, sent his daughter into the Holy Sect, entrusted his son to a mysterious force, even schemed the Demon Path Saint into his calculations... all of this, all of it, was so the three siblings would one day reunite and restore the Tianji Record to the world.

The tiny oil lamp finally burned out, the final wisp of flame struggling in the darkness a few times, then extinguished completely. The Servants' Quarters fell into pitch blackness, only the moonlight from the window casting a silver-white patch upon the floor. Chen Ji sat alone in the darkness, letting his tears dry upon his face. His fists were clenched tight, knuckles cracking. That was not anger, but something more terrifying than anger—that was hatred etched into his marrow, and killing intent about to burst forth.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's voice arose in the darkness, low and ice-cold, yet carrying a chilling calm) "Ye Qing, relay a message to Heaven's Eye for me—"

text.content: He slowly raised his head, moonlight illuminating his face, those eyes that usually carried a hint of timidity now deep as an abyss, as if harboring endless raging waves and seas. He spoke word by word: "The revenge for killing my father is a blood feud that cannot coexist under the same sky. Since it dared to touch my Chen family, I shall fight it to the death."

Ye Qing looked at this young man before her, suddenly feeling an inexplicable chill rise along her spine. Three years, she had seen countless gifted talents, yet never had she seen anyone's heart for vengeance as pure and terrifying as Chen Ji's. This youth who had walked the martial world under the guise of atrash finally shed all pretense this night. His fangs had quietly emerged.
